text: 有人想离开，也有人排队等着进：空乘下跪事件背后的职业围城 当服务人员处在消费者、平台规则或者企业考核的夹层里时，他们也应当有正常说“不”的权利。
text_en: Some want to leave, while others are lining up to get in: the career siege behind the flight attendant kneeling incident. When service workers are caught between consumers, platform rules, or corporate assessments, they should also have the right to say no normally.
